programme.title: 替身紙人
programme.desc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。

programme.title: Mama Ghost
programme.desc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需

programme.title: 夜迷藏
programme.desc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。

programme.title: The Ghost Writer
programme.desc: 一位渴望成名的作家決心撰寫一部暢銷小說來挽救自己的事業。他重返童年居所,這裡也是他成功作家父親神秘離世的地方。當他發現父親的最後手稿時,才意識到這部作品遠超出他的能力。因此,他決定抄襲這份作品,卻隨即

programme.title: The Ice Cream Truck
programme.desc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個冰淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…

programme.title: 替身紙人
programme.desc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。

programme.title: 殺手三分半鐘
programme.desc: 職業殺手雷振華在尖東某夜總會成功殺死黑道名流四哥等人後,悄然來到馬來西亞並住進唐人街對面一舊式旅館。唐人街的豪華酒店裡正舉行一個盛大婚禮,新郎石先生正是雷計畫用三分半鐘解決的目標,不料,未等雷下手,另一殺手已捷足先登,倒在地上卻是另一要人,雷頓時成了替罪羊。

programme.title: 魚美人
programme.desc: 張珍與金寵之女牡丹早有婚約,金寵卻欲退婚。張珍偶遇化身金牡丹樣子的鯉魚精,兩人漸生情愫。一天,金寵請包公來公斷兩個真假牡丹,包公為成全二人,推辭此案…

programme.title: 死囚
programme.desc: 流浪漢馮大剛被誤指為劫匪,遭逮捕後關押於死囚牢。真正的劫匪為了滅口,賄賂獄中扒手楊靈對馮大剛下毒手。楊靈明白馮大剛是冤枉的,於是暗中設法幫助他逃獄。誰料逃獄計劃意外失敗,最終兩人反而成為真正的死囚。

programme.title: 三十年細說從頭
programme.desc: 大導演李翰祥改編自己大受歡迎的專欄,盡現電影圈光怪陸離的趣事及傳聞,由愛將劉永和戴良純扮演不同角色,保證令你捧腹大笑。

programme.title: 追魂鏢
programme.desc: 故事描述青虹大俠劉文龍的徒弟鬍子峰不耐孤寂生活,非禮殺害村婦後逃走。劉收婦遺孤玉蟬為徒,玉蟬長大後與劉子玉郎相愛,但玉蟬偶遇胡,誤信劉是殺母仇人…

programme.title: 仙女下凡
programme.desc: 天宮仙女七妹嚮往凡間生活,某夜偷駕祥雲下凡來到香港。初到人間的她人生地不熟,險遭不法之徒欺騙,幸得經營負債累累孤兒院的董自立相救。面對貪婪富商覬覦院址、步步緊逼,七妹屢施法術相助,卻屢遭誤解為妖魅。兩人在困境中互相扶持,情愫漸生,共同守護孤兒院的未來。

programme.title: 踩綫
programme.desc: 本片由著名演員王鍾編導,為 1981年的社會寫實電影。故事描述,呂良偉與李修賢在片中均為中越混血兒, 由越南逃至澳門;呂於香港出生,可在港居留,乃與李分散;鄭則仕飾呂之叔父,為一幹練警探,即介紹呂加入員警世界,派其作臥底。後鄭一次與越南匪徒糾鬥中 遭殺害;而李則被牽涉入這宗凶案

programme.title: 醜聞
programme.desc: 在河北省某貪汙成風的小縣內,流浪漢甄明與賈亮因掌握一眾縣官的貪汙和醜聞證據,得以順水推舟假扮縣長,把各官員玩弄於股掌之中,峰迴路轉,結局卻出人意表。全片除帶出人生如戲的黑色幽默,也狠狠地鞭撻為官者殘民以自肥的無恥行為。

programme.title: 女殺手
programme.desc: 女殺手被組織控制,強逼去殺商界名人石英,險中殺人滅口的陷阱。她不想淪為殺人工具,決心進行報仇大計,故事曲折離奇

programme.title: 盤絲洞
programme.desc: 本片為邵氏「西遊記」系列的第三部作品。唐僧落入了七位蜘蛛精的手中,希望食唐僧肉而得到永生。悟空、八戒和沙僧因此大鬧盤絲洞拯救唐僧。

programme.title: 太極拳
programme.desc: 顧定是太極高手,卻隱藏身份為一名建築工人。當他的女朋友被惡霸強暴後,顧定唯有迫不得已出手讓惡霸受到應有的懲罰,彰顯公義。

programme.title: 七仙女
programme.desc: 故事描述少年董永賣身傳員外家,為奴以埋父骨;其孝心感動了七仙女,便幻成村姑,在六位仙姐下凡暗助下,為董縮減償還工作日,回復自由後,二人回董故家,但愉快的凡間生活能持續多久呢?

programme.title: 江湖三女俠
programme.desc: 故事講述,胸懷野心的朱天翔得知韓氏三姐妹若蘭、如玫、曉蓮家藏威力驚人的玄鐵神劍,若能奪得,必能戰勝「武林之尊」修德武館,稱霸江湖

programme.title: 阿牛出獄記
programme.desc: 續集中阿牛不幸的遭遇更令人心痛,當中不少更是笑中有淚的經歷。阿牛出獄後,再遇愛人阿花,可惜她已嫁為人妻;另一方面,戇直的阿牛仍不斷被狡猾的周大叔欺騙

programme.title: 花月良宵
programme.desc: 魔術師陳子新和歌女張曉萍一次避雨,誤闖豪華大宅,曉萍被屋主以爲她是失散孫女,對她甚爲喜愛,可是引起富豪外甥不忿,設計害子新和曉萍。萍將計就計,把陰谋揭發,成功成立了歌舞團。

programme.title: 包剪石沓
programme.desc: 幽默風趣的愛情喜劇,三個年青醫生常開道、史瑞科、蕭而可,被安排追求院長的三個女兒靈珍、靈珊、靈玲。三人以「包、剪、搥」來決定追求對象,他們的追女橋段層出不窮,用盡英雄救美、苦肉計、死纏爛打等愛情藥方,卻全部失靈,烏龍百出

programme.title: 獵人
programme.desc: 花花公子周國雄有一本「獵人日記」專門去記錄他四出獵艷的故事,周丟棄劉明華,又去追獵呂綺美,劉突然遭人殺死。後來周又去追求女學生朱麗珍…但當晚,呂遭殺死,警方向周追查。同時周想到和他親近的女人,一個一個的被殺死,嫌兇漸指向他,好像有人在陷害自己。周開始追查真相。

programme.title: 陸小鳳之決戰前後
programme.desc: 兩大武林劍客葉孤城與西門吹雪將於紫禁城決鬥。陸小鳳忖度二人素末謀面,又無利益衝突,無須決鬥,猜想當中一定事有蹊蹺。於是,他決定和花滿樓前往京城調查清楚,卻發現當中隱藏的陰謀…

programme.title: 人蛇鼠
programme.desc: 莊家農場獨子莊士德海外歸來,接手由胡麟管理的產業。胡一直與德之表妹曼玲勾結,圖取莊家產業,並欲利用曼玲美色迷惑德!怎知在阿芬飼養的小蛇「西西」幫助下,反令德與芬結成夫婦。後來胡買來一條專咬人的野老鼠,欲將德之初生嬰兒咬死,「西西」為救嬰兒,與野鼠作殊死搏鬥

programme.title: 廣東十虎與後五虎
programme.desc: 廣東十虎之一譚敏之侄譚聰,在賭館當巡場;一夜,十虎的徒弟及後人等四人,在賭場相聚時,旗人佟七帶著前清官之子小虎突襲,把譚聰殺死。原因是十虎之黎仁昭、譚敏等,昔日曾把父殺死,以助反清義士蔡民義脫險。小虎遂與師叔們聯手,殺死仍在世的十虎及其後人、傳人,為父報仇

programme.title: 乾隆下江南
programme.desc: 乾隆為體察民情,撇下侍衛假扮商人微服出訪江南,期間得知衙門有貪官欺壓百姓,導致民不聊生。這時乾隆遇上一名清廉的賣菜青年,二人合力教訓貪官一頓。最後,青年更被獲封為皇帝的近身侍衛。

programme.title: 賣命小子
programme.desc: 武林名門世家子弟袁鷹飛為了對付虎威鏢局少鏢頭關雲,拉攏四位失意江湖高手對付他。豈料四人與關雲不打不相識,反成好友。後袁鷹飛設下毒計害死關雲,四人悲憤交集,遂聯手為友復仇。

programme.title: 春暖花開
programme.desc: 故事描述,陳太太有女潔玉及美玉,潔玉已工作,美玉仍求學。適逢陳家有空房出租,少奇來租,一談即合;潔玉三個姊姊,皆與租客結婚,所以潔玉表姊趙靜蘭之母決仿效陳家租房選婿。未幾,一醫科學生欣農來租房,趙母見他是理想快婿,忙出租。原來少奇與欣農是同學,少奇老成寡言,被潔玉、美玉視為怪人,欣農則只顧談戀愛…

programme.title: 奪魂鈴
programme.desc: 故事描述,少年衛虎家遭左景龍、應天與楊剛所洗劫,父母幼弟被殺,姊衛芸被左劫走,頓時家破人亡。虎憤恨萬狀,放火燒毀家園,決心遠走天涯,找尋仇人報復;虎流浪各地,遇隱名大俠士,投拜為師,數年即習藝有成,遂往找仇人;虎抵雞兒鎮,遇弱女香香遭逼為娼,逐出手相助,擊退歹徒

programme.title: 文素臣
programme.desc: 「龍門七俠」之首文素臣命六俠入昭慶寺探察,他們不慎被主持明空殺害。明空更設計殺害林巡按,幸得文所救。文素臣潛入寺內與明空一戰為六俠報仇,林巡按下令官兵攻入昭慶寺,聯合文殲滅所有奸僧。

programme.title: 落葉飛刀
programme.desc: 日本財閥小川,為奪燕姓所有之森林,勾結劣紳關甫淩,屢次對森林主人燕劍光遊說,均被拒絕。小川收買燕家內侄徐千偷取燕老鑰匙,潛入密室,盜取地契。後被燕老發覺,徐千竟將燕老痛毆致死。關甫淩有女月花,與燕家小主人子飛,本有嫁娶之約,燕老死後,但鑑於其父與日人相勾結,國恨家仇,兒女私情無法兼顧,只得示意決絕…

programme.title: 魔界
programme.desc: 故事講述,警局偵緝部情侶探員鄭忠與王麗芬同往離島露營,半夜麗芬忽聞異聲,離營探看,突見綠光一閃,隨即著魔。翌日,王警官率眾處理一宗挾持人質案件,期間麗芬逕自開槍射殺劫匪,過程被雜誌記者阿古攝得,發現子彈竟能轉向殺人

programme.title: 玉面飛狐
programme.desc: 玉面閻羅夏梧與司馬秋同為鏢局金婁文之義子,後司馬鏢因偷取兩本功夫秘笈而傷夏之臉,並將師父殺死;夏抱初生女兒逃走。夏抱女入山修練,並傳武藝予女兒玉面飛狐,命她出山向司馬劫鏢報仇。後飛狐遭司馬擒住,幸為書生徐繩所救。飛狐回山后,父疑心其與徐有私情,把她關在地窟中

programme.title: 萬花迎春
programme.desc: 歌舞團台柱陳君邁賦閒多時後,應徵當富家女梅倩如的司機,竟被誤傳戀情。倩如為查明流言的來源,假扮記者採訪歌舞團,期間君邁與倩如暗生好感,經過一番試探後,二人終一舞定情。

programme.title: 少林五祖

programme.title: 足球金童:C羅
programme.desc: 從年輕的葡萄牙神童開始見證有史以來最偉大的球員之一的旅程這是絕無僅有的基斯坦勞朗拿度

programme.title: 基利安姆巴佩:足壇新星
programme.desc: 很少有球員能像基利安・姆巴佩一樣,捕捉全球球迷的想像力在短短十多年內,他從默默無名的新秀,迅速躍升為世界上最知名,最具影響力的足球明星之一

programme.title: 梅西:天選之人
programme.desc: 這部紀錄片帶領觀眾深入且全面地回顧萊昂內爾・梅西的非凡職業生涯--從阿根廷羅薩裡奧的平凡起點,到成為全球足球傳奇巨星的歷程

programme.title: 安迪莫瑞:勝利之路
programme.desc: 從小鎮天才到世界第一,這部紀錄片記錄了穆雷追求卓越的堅持,與傷病的搏鬥,以及他作為網壇最具啟發性人物之一的永恆傳奇

programme.title: 基利安姆巴佩:足壇新星
programme.desc: 很少有球員能像基利安・姆巴佩一樣,捕捉全球球迷的想像力在短短十多年內,他從默默無名的新秀,迅速躍升為世界上最知名,最具影響力的足球明星之一

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #4
programme.desc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #4
programme.desc: 求偶是最強大的本能之一從美麗的到奇怪的,本集探索動物王國裡最驚奇的交配儀式

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #5
programme.desc: 本集探索世上最毒的動物,揭示毒物和毒液如何讓牠們在生存鬥爭中獲得競爭優勢

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #6
programme.desc: 本集探索大自然中最頑強的動物如何適應地球上一些最惡劣環境中的極端條件

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #6
programme.desc: 在愛爾蘭,雙胞胎與伊凡娜一家共享曲棍球對決,傳統舞蹈,《哈利波特》回憶殺,並揭開詭譎迷人的鄉間冒險序幕!

programme.title: 臺灣之最 #1
programme.desc: 碧姬探索臺灣五大另類療法,並瞭解那些至今仍保留傳統的療法

programme.title: 臺灣之最 #2
programme.desc: 祖莉探索臺灣五大有著臺灣風味的西餐跟她瞭解為何這些食物在當地人和遊客中如此受歡迎

programme.title: 臺灣之最 #3
programme.desc: 祖莉探索臺北五間最多善信到訪的寺廟跟她瞭解各寺廟崇拜的神明,以及人們在各寺廟祈禱的內容

programme.title: 臺灣之最 #4
programme.desc: 祖莉探索臺灣五大原住民美食跟她參觀兩個原住民村莊,並瞭解這些食物的製作方法

programme.title: 臺灣之最 #5
programme.desc: 碧姬探索臺灣五大獨特街頭美食她也嘗試製作一些,並瞭解它們各具特色的原因

programme.title: 臺灣之最 #6
programme.desc: 祖莉探索五大臺灣製造的頂尖發明細訴這些改變生活的物品的起源,並瞭解為何那麼多人喜歡它們

programme.title: 臺灣之最 #7
programme.desc: 碧姬探索臺灣地鐵站五大裝置藝術,並細訴它們如何呼應這些車站的地理位置

programme.title: 臺灣之最 #8
programme.desc: 碧姬探索臺灣五大咖啡品牌她向獲獎的咖啡師們瞭解能在激烈競爭中脫穎而出的原因

programme.title: 生存邊緣 #2
programme.desc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險

programme.title: 生存邊緣 #3
programme.desc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智慧統治著地球和我們人工智慧將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險

programme.title: 打造不可能 #1
programme.desc: 獲伯沿著巴拿馬運河旅行,以瞭解無法被徵服的地峽如何屈服於堅定的工程師的意志和技巧之下,從而創造出現今的七大奇蹟之一

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #8
programme.desc: 安斯利來到摩洛哥,但他沒有去馬拉喀什或卡薩布蘭加,而是去了豐富多彩,混亂而夢幻的費茲雜亂無序的麥地那是世界遺產,也是通往另一個時代的門戶

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #9
programme.desc: 安斯利到訪檳島首都喬治敦,馬來西亞人發現這個沉迷美食的國家中最好的街頭食品

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #10
programme.desc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最後一站到訪問約旦的安曼,那是來自伊拉克,黎巴嫩,巴勒斯坦和敘利亞中東一族叫作家的交匯處

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #1
programme.desc: 華倫在世界著名的克魯格國家公園及附近開展第二趟南非美食之行

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #2
programme.desc: 約翰尼斯堡是探索南非的門戶城市!華倫在本集沉迷於深受當地人和遊客喜愛的桑頓區及周邊和精彩的國際口味

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #3
programme.desc: 在你從未見過的南非狂野東北海岸,華倫會發現自己愛上那空蕩蕩的海灘,粗獷的開放汪洋和充滿野生河馬的水道

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #4
programme.desc: 華倫在本集體驗當地豐富的野生物種,他主要在追蹤和尋找難以捉摸並瀕臨絕種的非洲野狗

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #5
programme.desc: 花園大道果真是南非的滄海遺珠,它是一條延伸200公裡的沿海公路,以其迷人的多樣性和無出其右的荒野而聞名

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #6
programme.desc: 華倫抵達開普敦,這不會是這座城市的平凡美食探索之旅;華倫在整集節目中致力深入研究南非一種特殊的烹飪風格- 開普馬來

programme.title: 席琳狄翁:愛無止境
programme.desc: 席琳狄翁是家喻戶曉的名字,象徵著無與倫比的音樂才華然而,她的人生並非一帆風順跟隨我們一同揭開傳奇背後的故事--從聲名鵲起的爆紅之路,到塑造她非凡事業的個人考驗

programme.title: 摩根費裡曼:不可思議的生涯
programme.desc: 深入探索摩根・費裡曼的人生旅程--從奮鬥與逆境,到塑造好萊塢的傳奇地位與獨一無二的標誌性嗓音

programme.title: 丹佐華盛頓:美國代表人物
programme.desc: 這部深度紀錄片探討丹佐・華盛頓的非凡歷程,這位影壇巨星重新定義了好萊塢領銜男演員的形象與影響力

programme.title: 空中戰士 10 #2
programme.desc: 瞭解龍捲風戰鬥轟炸機如何及為何在多年來不同場合都大派用場

programme.title: 空中戰士 10 #3
programme.desc: 從越戰的叢林到中東的沙漠戰爭,見證 F-111戰鬥轟炸機的行動

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #1
programme.desc: 華倫在世界著名的克魯格國家公園及附近開展第二趟南非美食之行

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

高朋滿座#130粵
programme.desc: 眾人趕回家，原來喜重煮十年沒製作的鹹蛋肉餅煲仔飯。慶提議中秋節時由喜包辦美食給家人享用，其實喜只懂煮這種煲仔飯。義帶妙喜學廚，可是喜的廚藝沒有因而大進。中秋節終於來到，朋暗地計劃出手救母。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#5粵普PG
programme.desc: 燕臨躲在房間喝得爛醉，雪寧得知他並無懷疑自己欺瞞他，只是擔心她該如何自處，很是感動。薛家的絲船沉了，這些年薛家以漕運結黨營私，故必須把事情壓下來。張遮要向家裡退婚，姚惜來質問雪寧和張遮究竟是什麼關係。

programme.title: 食平DD粵
programme.desc: 肥媽示範日式叉燒、日式醬油、豬骨湯底的製法，甚至連拉麵亦自己買料搓成，零舍彈牙！不少主婦在燜五花腩時，常被豬肉出油過多的問題困擾，肥媽只是輕描淡寫便解決問題。今集她怎樣令芒果斑蘭班戟的味道更上一層樓？

programme.title: 才駿HASHTAG 滙豐工商金融戶口健康之道粵
programme.desc: 《才駿HASHTAG》匯聚各界精英，每周與您分享名家視角、更新市場焦點熱話。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 不少癌症患者選用中醫加上西醫的聯合治療，中醫學主張「扶正培本」，以其治癌的成效數字怎樣？中藥如何減低治癌西藥產生的副作用？前來的中醫師亦提到香港中醫醫院、跨境醫健通等政策為病人帶來的實際幫助。殿堂級歌手葉振棠唱過無數金曲，他將再開騷，這次為何邀龍婷出任嘉賓？龍婷參加《中年好聲音》前已和棠哥合作過，當時感覺如何？二人預告演唱會將發放驚喜，還分享養聲秘技。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐示範「麻香爆炒雞軟骨」。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵
programme.desc: 患者多為婦女的乳癌、子宮內膜癌等頑疾，永城以為事不關己，事實卻非如此！藝員林淑敏是乳癌康復者，她透露起初是自行觸摸時察覺異常。醫生教大家自檢步驟，另介紹新式3D檢查技術；基因測試可及早識別患癌風險，醫生建議哪些人士接受偵測？傳聞豆漿、木瓜不適合乳癌患者，營養師指出相關謬誤。子宮內膜癌的病徵相對明顯，及早發現可透過微創手術治療，醫生細說詳情。永城也會了解男士接種HPV疫苗，如何有助減低伴侶染病風險。

programme.title: 才駿HASHTAG 滙豐工商金融戶口健康之道粵
programme.desc: 《才駿HASHTAG》匯聚各界精英，每周與您分享名家視角、更新市場焦點熱話。

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#12粵PG
programme.desc: 譚彬在遊戲機中心玩射擊遊戲，江翹中途加入，兩人和好。有人目擊明翔、譚彬脅持經琛，警方向君豪求證，君豪否認。江揚查到高哲和趙家的恩怨，警方對俠盜集團展開人盯人策略；君豪交贖金當日，俠盜集團仍順利擺脫跟蹤。君豪在城門河邊放下公事包，然後跳河，警方發現袋內並無贖款。江揚決定放眾人一馬。原來今次是經琛和高哲為對付君豪合演的一場戲，高哲亦趁機考驗蓉蓉。中醫指美莉的不孕無藥可治，美莉終向江揚坦白。

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普
programme.desc: 在小鎮上生活著六個小朋友，在他們的日常生活中，會遇到形形色色的問題，有朋友之間的情感問題，有生活中的安全問題，有待人處事的行為規範，美妙世界的科學原理

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這回「廠長話」遊戲，個子最小的零食小兵因大意犯錯，率先出局。剩下的隊友原本力求爭勝，卻在某個廠長指令中僅完成了一半動作，最終亦被淘汰，究竟發生何事？果園收集任務方面，兩隊為求盡快完成挑戰，不惜以爬行方式前進；更有女隊員要牽着團長跨越障礙。在「溶化之橋」關卡，所有小兵皆成功將雪糕球運送至終點。有女隊員於第二輪時勇敢挑戰更多球數，其精神與勇氣值得嘉許。

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 今福彥四郎苦思如何才可以，成為一個令人覺得可依靠的班長。北石照代被嘲笑連基礎也未學好，因此向山本老師求指點。虎若很期待照星先生的特別指導。豈料照星先生只顧指導別人，令虎若感到失望。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 糖尿上眼全稱為糖尿病視網膜病變，因長期血糖過高損害視網膜微絲血管所致。早期通常無痛無感，但若惡化可能導致視力模糊、飛蚊症、視野缺損甚至失明。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 香港的驕傲粵
programme.desc: 九龍灣某公共電單車泊位疑長期被佔用，有市民多次向政府部門投訴，惟情況未見明顯改善。馬鞍山有公屋住戶接獲樓下單位漏水投訴，事主縱願意承擔維修責任，但樓下單位一方拒絕讓維修人員入屋，反而交出多張索償單據，費用更達數萬元。事主懷疑樓下一方「碰瓷」而拒絕付款，結果自此遭受對方的連串滋擾行為……黎耀祥、麥長青再度合作拍攝旅遊節目《江湖見》，二人受訪分享過程中的深刻點滴。另介紹專上院校如何培育學生的高科知識。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2840粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: Minnie出任法律部主管，家聰設法「搞對抗」。Minnie回家仍要為家聰的文件「執手尾」，家聰卻不斷出招騷擾，令她苦不堪言。莫明詩替家聰不值，並察覺家聰的心思全在Minnie身上，認為是她故意引起注意，遂暗中對付她，意外取得載有重要文件的usb，令她得罪貴客。家聰本想藉usb立功，但他偷聽敢威責怪Minnie，意外聽到意想不到的秘密。家聰決意歸還usb，遂找藉口走進Minnie住所，伺機歸還……

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Si 益生菌呈獻：非份之罪#2粵PG

programme.title: 食玩假期呈獻：江湖見粵
programme.desc: 都江堰是二千多年來仍在運作的水利工程，多得秦國水吏科學家李冰，採用順應自然的聰明設計，造就四川一年四季水量穩定。川菜具有廿四種獨特味型，主持們接受旅遊達人陳志華款待，感受既傳統又創新的川菜江湖。黎耀祥、麥包乘搭遊船，以船家觀看高七十米的樂山大佛石雕，經歷三代人雕成的大型佛像，背後有何故事？又有甚麼精密設計令它不被雨水侵蝕？再往蘇稽古鎮一試「蹺腳牛肉」，說是牛肉，清朝時卻只是牛雜且要蹺着腳來吃？

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 九龍灣某公共電單車泊位疑長期被佔用，有市民多次向政府部門投訴，惟情況未見明顯改善。馬鞍山有公屋住戶接獲樓下單位漏水投訴，事主縱願意承擔維修責任，但樓下單位一方拒絕讓維修人員入屋，反而交出多張索償單據，費用更達數萬元。事主懷疑樓下一方「碰瓷」而拒絕付款，結果自此遭受對方的連串滋擾行為……黎耀祥、麥長青再度合作拍攝旅遊節目《江湖見》，二人受訪分享過程中的深刻點滴。另介紹專上院校如何培育學生的高科知識。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 不少癌症患者選用中醫加上西醫的聯合治療，中醫學主張「扶正培本」，以其治癌的成效數字怎樣？中藥如何減低治癌西藥產生的副作用？前來的中醫師亦提到香港中醫醫院、跨境醫健通等政策為病人帶來的實際幫助。殿堂級歌手葉振棠唱過無數金曲，他將再開騷，這次為何邀龍婷出任嘉賓？龍婷參加《中年好聲音》前已和棠哥合作過，當時感覺如何？二人預告演唱會將發放驚喜，還分享養聲秘技。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐示範「麻香爆炒雞軟骨」。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵

programme.title: 高朋滿座#130粵

programme.title: 我係小廚神3粵

programme.title: 高朋滿座#131粵

programme.title: 命轉皇后#6粵普PG

programme.title: 香港本色粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵

programme.title: 食平DD粵

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#13粵PG

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 花牌是香港一項非物質文化遺產，其大小、用料、顏色都十分引人注目，可以說是廣告牌的前身。本集「Kids’ Notes」，花牌製作師傅細說這門傳統紮作技藝的變遷。傳統的花牌是用竹製作，師傅卻曾為了迎合安全標準、將工藝帶到海外，改用不鏽鋼及鋁片作「新嘗試」，有何深刻畫面？時代變遷，嘉賓認為花牌也有「進步」，加入LED、3D顯示等元素，變得更吸睛。花牌亦可應用到更多場合與節日，歡迎大家「打卡」留念！

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日

programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
獵鷹#12粵PG
programme.desc: 崔福與祥旺分別負責毒品入口及提煉工作，聽聞陳水有意插手其中，即往找一帆共商對策，但一帆對毒品之事已感索然，兩人唯有自行處理。大偉被陳水重用，阿全不忿，向崔福透露陳水有毒品運港，並慫恿他半途截去毒品。崔福果然奪去毒品，並給阿全酬勞，阿全免陳水追殺，詐謂毒品落在祥旺手中，陳水大怒，往找祥旺晦氣，兩人因而結怨。文昇往夜總會找大偉，但見他判若兩人，又與絲絲舉止親暱，轉告嘉琦，嘉琦氣憤，不理睬大偉。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵
programme.desc: 心臟在結構、運作上均是複雜的器官，急性心肌梗塞更是致命疾病，胸口痛、呼吸困難、飆汗是徵狀，但原來胃部不適、消化不良是非典型病徵。兩位急性心肌梗塞康復者述說當時病況，二人都非完成一次手術便一勞永逸，還會牽引出甚麼心血管問題？醫生介紹相關的檢查與手術新技術，並提醒「三低一高零反式」的飲食習慣可大大預防發病機會！此外，健身教練向主持宋宛穎、魏韵芝傳授三個中等程度的強心動作；體內的膽固醇水平又可怎樣減低？

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#14粵PG
programme.desc: 江揚向高哲坦承夫妻間有問題，又自認踢偉成，高哲叫江揚要多點包容美莉。大海知偉成欠高利貸，又屢次涉迷姦少女，想藉此捉其痛腳。安娜混入偉成私竇，當偉成想向安娜淋漒水之際，大海趕至飛身保護安娜。波子的天竺鼠嚇倒有身孕的潔心，被英杰斥責後出街找寵物，險被車撞，蓉蓉不滿想取回波子的撫養權。英杰投資失利，想監守自盜公司的珠寶，君豪答應介紹賊人。波子離家出走，高哲陪蓉蓉到珠寶行找英杰，遇賊人打劫，蓉蓉更被挾持。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#132粵
programme.desc: 麗勝出第二回合比試，娜以金磚收買眾人，不果。第三輪比試是將亨綁到沙灘上，哪一方尋獲亨者為勝。比試終於結束，結果由高麗勝出，事情圓滿解決，亨利父親立即下令，要高麗親手下廚，以便考驗這名「兒媳」。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#7粵普PG
programme.desc: 燕臨發現薛國公私囤儲備，燕牧決定調查清楚。謝危吐露對雪寧的想法，讓雪寧釋懷。聖上聽謝危的建議讓伯游接任尚書，雪寧大感錯愕。燕牧回京途中遇刺殺，燕臨及時趕到幫助。公公在雪寧房中搜到一封信，指她勾結逆黨…

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 一種普通食物，令聖地牙哥的漢堡包得獎；發霉的食材，煲成湯竟能醫百病；一件物件，令東京某麵店不用火亦可替客人翻熱湯汁；麥長青、黃浩然能夠猜中答案，要感謝的竟是攝影師？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 馬國明與唐詩詠忙於拍劇，但接獲Do姐邀請，當然即到擔任嘉賓！台灣「問題專員」找來一款加入「黑材料」的蛋卷，究竟是甚麼特別食材？要平遊東京，住Hostel是常識吧！書店主題Hostel為客人送上貼心禮物，內裡有何乾坤？K小姐走進首爾的漁市場，發現鮟鱇魚限售雌性。詩詠對答案似乎胸有成竹，可否猜中原因？來到以積分兌換貨幣的關鍵時刻，面對四個不太熟悉的國家貨幣，二人會如何抉擇？

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 戀人的謊言
programme.desc: 舒菲和林菲從小一起長大，姐妹情深，形影不離，在大學期間英年才俊奇然學長喜歡林菲，但林菲對奇然沒有感覺，暗戀奇然的舒菲借用林菲的名字和奇然書信來往，姐妹兩同時進入購物電視台上班，意外發現自己的上司居然是奇然，奇然依然鍾情林菲，舒菲暗戀心情破碎，心思放工作上，偶然結識導演藍天，兩人互生情愫，而林菲職場失意，又得知舒菲當年利用她的名字和奇然書信來往，於是陷害舒菲泄露商業機密，害公司倒閉，舒菲陷入輿論壓力中，藍天陪在舒菲身邊，拆穿林菲的謊言，最後林菲真心悔過，和舒菲和好如初，舒菲也收穫和愛情和事業。

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂(完)
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 依法相愛吧(完)
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 戀人的謊言
programme.desc: 舒菲和林菲從小一起長大，姐妹情深，形影不離，在大學期間英年才俊奇然學長喜歡林菲，但林菲對奇然沒有感覺，暗戀奇然的舒菲借用林菲的名字和奇然書信來往，姐妹兩同時進入購物電視台上班，意外發現自己的上司居然是奇然，奇然依然鍾情林菲，舒菲暗戀心情破碎，心思放工作上，偶然結識導演藍天，兩人互生情愫，而林菲職場失意，又得知舒菲當年利用她的名字和奇然書信來往，於是陷害舒菲泄露商業機密，害公司倒閉，舒菲陷入輿論壓力中，藍天陪在舒菲身邊，拆穿林菲的謊言，最後林菲真心悔過，和舒菲和好如初，舒菲也收穫和愛情和事業。

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.desc: Oh no, Jeremy ran out of gas! Troy selects the most perfect truck to refuel him: Tyson the Tanker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Francis the Forklift helps at the construction site
programme.desc: Edgar made a mess at the construction site! Troy selects the best truck to help with the clean-up: Francis the Forklift!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyler the Tyke steals candy
programme.desc: Tyler stole some candy from Baby Francis! Troy selects the bravest, fastest car to stop him: Matt the Police Car!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Chuck the Cherry Picker saves the day!
programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Carl the Super Truck helps Frank the Firetruck
programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT

Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S06 - Ant
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say "ant", and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of ants - a black one, another with two feelers and a teeny-weeny tiny ant! There are marching ants, a strong one, and Dee meets a queen ant! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Mr Kite Takes Flight
programme.desc: As Messy monster is about to take a bite out of his delicious green sock, it gets blown away!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Ice Cream Float
programme.desc: Betty's new ice cream flavour is so light, it makes everybody in town float in the air. How will Mojo and Bo get everyone's feet back on the ground? By floating up there with them!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Promises
programme.desc: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mystery Seeds
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds it's time for some gardening!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Big Ben, England
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are on a mission to get Big Ben back to the Elizabeth Tower in time for it to chime at midnight! To the Vroomster!

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Kids
programme.desc: A quick trip to the shops proves tricky for Dad, when Bingo and Bluey want to play a game of 'Kids'. Now Bluey is Mum, Bingo's her baby and for Dad however, he is a very naughty boy.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Typewriter

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Phones
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!

programme.desc: Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Café in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch is busy with the Playtimers making a tasty treat called Munchy Muddy Meadows.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called "Swordswomen Two." Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japanese to take Yen's property and wants to murder him. It is a tough choice between family and love...

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japanese to take Yen's property and wants to murder him. It is a tough choice between family and love...

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur. Her two colleagues die mangled in a lift accident and Inspector Wang is injured at his desk by a

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: The formidable swordswoman Silver Fox was a child when her father was senselessly wounded by his step brother, and her mother raped. It is payback time eighteen years later, as her father trains her up with kung fu to take revenge on his behalf.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become "The Five Shaolin Masters".

programme.title: Call to Arms
programme.desc: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler. Adventure, intrigue, death and tragedy reigns before the triumphant clash of the armies.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: The Golden Buddha
programme.desc: A map indicating the location of the Chan's family heirloom is hidden in three Golden Buddha statues. Paul, an insurance agent, finds one statue by chance and Chan's daughter has another one. This makes them targets of treasure-hunting criminals and they have to team up to defeat them before unveiling the hidden secrets.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own "Eight Diagram Pole Fight" and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gang's girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the "Anonymous Heroes" of the revolution.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Brothers from the Walled City
programme.desc: Two orphaned brothers growing up in Kowloon's Walled City - the place where people are forced to live with indecent businesses of sex, gambling and drugs controlled by triads - take very different life paths. Chin works at a cabaret but keeps away from sins, while Kang is drawn to the sleazy underworld. Are their destinies shaped by the "walls"?

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called "Five Poison Web", spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Ying's father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt "Shaolin Hand Lock" from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling's house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend "Investiture of the Gods", this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: The Sword Stained with Royal Blood
programme.desc: Adapted from Jin Yong's novel, the movie depicts the havoc breaking out in the martial arts world when a warrior on the run uncovers a sword, a training manual, a treasure map and a secret message on the body of a deceased martial arts master.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: An elderly landowner marries young Dai Nan to keep his inheritance away from his unscrupulous nephew before he dies. When Dai Nan brings along the deed to meet his other nephew, a series of amusing incidents happen with this "young" auntie, the nephew and his son. Kara Hui won Best Actress in the first Hong Kong Film Awards for her role as Dai Nan.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the ‘Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang’s custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip’s boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes…

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi’s husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair…

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika’s mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn…

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong’s biggest stars

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law’s affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother’s death?

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao’s house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao’s descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: City Breaks - Narlai & Jawai

programme.title: Viajar Peru - Lima, Peru

programme.title: 50 States Florida - Orlando
programme.desc: Orlando surprises Iona by being a lot more interesting than just theme parks.

programme.title: Burn Appetit - Rattenberg, Austria

programme.title: Off The Grid Gabon - Lope National Park, Gabon

programme.title: World Spas - Mines Wellness, Malaysia

programme.title: Viajar Peru - Trujillo, Peru

programme.title: 50 States Florida - Florida Keys

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland - Perth
programme.desc: Robbie’s adventures in Perth kick off with him immersing himself in the historic grandeur of the Scone Castle.

programme.title: Burn Appetit - Zillertal, Austria

programme.title: 50 States Tennessee - Nashville

programme.title: Burn Appetit - Ziller Valley, Austria

programme.title: Country Spirit - EP24
programme.desc: KOO SAI LUNG (CHUN PUI) is the manager of a wine factory. He adopts his ex-girlfriend’s illegitimate son, SHUNG (LAM KA TUNG), out of kindness. SHUNG is cheerful and tolerates any kind of abuse. LUNG’s sister, YIU (TANG SHUI MAN), loves SHUNG. However, she cannot forget her former love KOU (TSANG WAI KUEN) who is dead.

programme.title: The Driving Power - EP20
programme.desc: MUI (CHENG SIU CHOW, ADAM) is a middle-aged man who has never had a proper job. Throughout his life, he has been relying on his family and living like a playboy. His biggest achievements are marrying a singer, YUNG (YIP TUNG, CECILIA) and raising their daughter CHU (YE MICHELLE). MUI and YUNG love each other very much even after being married for more than 20 years. However, deep down, MUI is still a playboy.

programme.title: Communion - EP8
programme.desc: After getting divorced, Au Yiu-cho (Kwok Chun On) and Tang Lai-kuen (Alice Chan) operate two restaurants coincidentally called Yuet Tak House in Hong Kong and on the mainland respectively. They never have issues with each other. In 2022, Lai-kuen abruptly returns to Hong Kong to open a branch. She even declares she wants to obtain the rights to the Yuet Tak House trademark through legal channels.

programme.title: Guts of Man - EP13
programme.desc: TUNG FEI (CHAN KIN FUNG, SAMMUL) ignores his late father’s last will and sneaks out of the Taohua Village, where he grew up, without his sister LAM’s (KOI MING FAI, JOYCE) knowing it. He meets a fisherman’s son SHEUNG FOON (NG CHEUK HAI, RON) on the way. He and FOON travel to the Qiantang River to see the tides. They meet a tycoon’s daughter YING HIU SUET (CHO, MANDY LEE) and FEI falls in love with her at first sight.

programme.title: Provocateur - EP8
programme.desc: Following deaths of his first and second wife, cosmetic mogul CHEUK KWAN-LAM (Gallen Lo), who is left alone living with his step-daughter CHEUK MAN-LEI (Jacqueline Wong), tries to turn over a new leaf. As fate would have it, he encounters a resourceful young man called POON SIU-KIT (Fred Cheng), through whom he sees a younger version of himself, so he cannot help developing a kindly feeling for him.
